Task: Batteries -Inspect overboard vents and vent lines for damage and obstructions.
Air Cycle Machine Oil Level- Inspect oil level.
Propeller Deice Slip Rings, Brushes and Boots - Check for condition and security of attachment.
Engine - (refer to Garrett Engine Maintenance Manual for Periodic Inspection Requirements and Checks.
Fuel Lines - Inspect fuel supply lines for deterioration, chafing, fuel leaks and security of installation.
Engine Controls - Check travel and security of installation, routing and evidence of damage (engine compartment).
Engine Exhaust System - Inspect for cracks, distortion, security of installation and evidence of damage.
Starter-Generator Brush Holders - Inspect for cracks, wear, cleanliness; brush springs for proper tension and looseness.
Starter-Generator Brushes -Inspect for cracks, wear and cleanliness.
Starter-Generators - Inspect for security of installation, terminal block and electrical connections for cleanliness, evidence of heat or electrical arcing and evidence of damage.
Tires - Inspect for pressure, wear and cuts.
